title: Mehmonxonada: Is there …?
can_do: Mehmonxonada nima borligini so'raysiz va qisqa javob olasiz
why: «Lift bormi?», «Sochiq bormi?» — sayohatda eng ko'p beriladigan savollar. Ular there is dan yasaladi, faqat tartib o'zgaradi.

rule.title: Is there …? / Are there …? — savol shakli

points.text: Savol so'z tartibini almashtirish bilan yasaladi: Is there a lift? — lift bormi, Are there any towels? — sochiq bormi. Yordamchi do ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: Is there a lift in the hotel?
Are there any towels in the room?

points.text: Sanaladigan birlik uchun Is there, ko'plik uchun Are there: Is there a restaurant? — Are there any restaurants?

examples.en: Are there any shops near the hotel?

points.text: Savol va inkorda some emas, any ishlatiladi: Are there any towels? Is there any Wi-Fi?

examples.en: Is there any Wi-Fi in the room?

points.text: Qisqa javobda there saqlanadi: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. / Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. Yes, it is deb javob berilmaydi.

examples.en: — Is there a lift? — Yes, there is.
— Are there any rooms? — No, there aren't.

points.text: Qo'shimcha savollar: What time is breakfast? — nonushta qachon, How much is it? — narxi qancha, Could I have a key card? — kalit kartani olsam bo'ladimi.

examples.en: Could I have a key card, please?

head: Savol
Javob
rows: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

common_errors.why: Savol faqat so'z tartibini almashtirish bilan yasaladi, intonatsiya bilan emas.
Birlik ot bilan Is there ishlatiladi, ko'plik bilan Are there.

common_errors.wrong: — Is there a lift? — Yes, there has.
common_errors.right: — Is there a lift? — Yes, there is.
common_errors.why: Javobda there is / there are takrorlanadi, have fe'li bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.
Ko'plik bilan are, savolda esa some emas — any.

common_errors.wrong: — Is there a pool? — Yes, it is.
common_errors.right: — Is there a pool? — Yes, there is.
common_errors.why: It haqida emas, joyda nima borligi haqida gap ketyapti, shuning uchun there saqlanadi.

words.example: Is there a lift in the hotel?
Are there any towels in the room?
Is there air conditioning in the room?
The hotel has a swimming pool.
Is there any parking near the hotel?
Could I have a key card?
My room is on the third floor.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: darak gapni savolga aylantirish: There is a lift → Is there a lift?
«There is a lift?», «Yes, there has», «some towels» xatolarini topish
mehmonxonada kerak bo'ladigan beshta savolni tuzish
reception bilan dialog: savol va javob
tinglab, savol «Is there» yoki «Are there» ekanini aniqlash

final.task: Mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qilyapsiz. Beshta savol yozing va administratorning javobini ham yozing.

skill_task.task: Mehmonxonaga beshta savol bilan qisqa xat yozing: lift, nonushta, Wi-Fi, to'xtash joyi va narx haqida.
